verdict.rationale: Rippling's own docs show that employees can request time off and that time off syncs with payroll from a single system, which covers the payroll-application part of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows defining PTO policies, accrual rules, or time-off-specific approval workflows; the approvals claim is generic and role-based, not PTO-specific. missing for 10: PTO policy definition, accrual configuration, PTO approval workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can define PTO policies with accruals and approvals that apply automatically to payroll

citations.quote: Sync hours, time off, deductions, and more with payroll from a single global system.
Let employees clock in, request time off, and view timesheets—all in a single, easy-to-use app.
